baseline: Run once with aigent-design plus aigent-business-sites and once with aigent-design alone.

evals.prompt: The existing checkout button becomes unreadable while the request is pending. Fix only that state, keep the current design system, and do not add dependencies.
evals.expected_output: A minimal root-cause code change in the existing button or shared state primitive, plus one focused regression check. No brand workshop or speculative design documents.
assertions: The response classifies the work as a tiny or local fix and avoids the full design workflow.
The implementation reuses the existing button/state system and adds no dependency.
The pending state remains accessible and prevents duplicate activation.
At least one focused runnable check covers the non-trivial state transition.

evals.prompt: Add a customer stories route to an established B2B site. Use the current components, tokens, analytics naming, and CMS model. The page needs one featured case and a searchable archive.
evals.expected_output: A route-level brief and implementation that inherit the established system, add only necessary CMS/search behavior, cover states, and preserve analytics and accessibility conventions.
assertions: The output inventories and reuses existing brand, component, token, CMS, and analytics conventions.
The page includes loading, empty, error, populated, and long-content behavior for the archive.
Search state is shareable or recoverable through the URL when the existing stack supports it.
The output does not initiate a new visual identity or introduce an overlapping component library.

evals.prompt: Modernize this service-business homepage without changing its URLs, navigation labels, contact form fields, call-tracking number, conversion events, legal copy, or approved logo. Mobile conversion matters most.
evals.expected_output: A preservation inventory, low-risk modernization plan, and implementation that improves hierarchy and mobile usability while keeping business infrastructure intact.
assertions: The output explicitly preserves every named route, navigation, form, analytics, legal, phone, and logo contract.
Modernization starts with typography, hierarchy, spacing, states, and responsive recomposition before structural replacement.
The mobile primary action remains visible and usable without hiding essential information.
The final checks include form delivery, call tracking, analytics deduplication, keyboard access, and responsive inspection.

evals.prompt: Design and build a greenfield marketing site for a reconciliation product used by operations teams. The product compares records, surfaces mismatches, and creates an auditable review trail. No customer logos or performance metrics are available yet.
evals.expected_output: A truthful product model, three materially different directions, one selected visual world, an evidence-led implementation, and release QA without fabricated social proof.
assertions: The output uses product demonstration, process transparency, or labeled examples instead of invented logos, testimonials, or metrics.
The direction candidates differ in governing composition and expressive logic, not merely color.
The chosen direction defines a signature system, restraint system, mobile recomposition, and implementation risks.
The implemented page contains real semantic content, states, responsive behavior, and one product-specific detail that passes the soul test.

evals.prompt: Create an editorial membership site for a weekly field journal. Reading comes first; membership is secondary. It needs an issue archive, author pages, sponsor disclosures, accessible media transcripts, and a mobile reading experience.
evals.expected_output: An editorial-spine system with strong reading hierarchy, honest sponsor treatment, useful archive behavior, and restrained membership conversion.
assertions: The output prioritizes reading measure, hierarchy, recency, authorship, sourcing, taxonomy, and return navigation.
Sponsor and affiliate material is visually and semantically distinguished from editorial content.
Membership prompts appear after value is established and do not interrupt the critical reading path.
Archive, transcripts, keyboard navigation, mobile typography, and content extremes receive explicit coverage.

evals.prompt: Audit this deployed marketing site for design quality, accessibility, responsive behavior, performance, SEO, analytics, and generic AI patterns. Do not change any files.
evals.expected_output: A verified audit with positive findings, prioritized defects, root causes, exact corrections, evidence, and explicit uncertainty where live access is insufficient. No silent edits.
assertions: The output does not edit files or represent unobserved behavior as verified.
Findings use severity, location, evidence, impact, root cause, correction, and a smallest regression check.
The audit separates design critique from technical audit and records what should be preserved.
Generic-pattern findings explain the underlying repetition, meaninglessness, mismatch, or technical harm rather than merely saying it looks AI-generated.

source: Adapted from Ultra Web Design evals (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/wrg32786/Ultra-web-design
